# ghost/der-die-das

Der Die Das (F-Droid): practise the grammatical gender of about 10000 German nouns. Shows a noun with its English meaning, you answer der, die or das. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/der-die-das
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/der-die-das open_practice --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/der-die-das get_word --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/der-die-das answer --device <serial> --param article=<article>
ghost skill run ghost/der-die-das answer_many --device <serial> --param articles=<articles>
ghost skill run ghost/der-die-das get_stats --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_practice`: Open the Der Die Das German noun practice
- `get_word`: What German noun is shown in Der Die Das now?
- `answer`: Answer die for the German noun in the trainer
- `answer_many`: Answer der, die, das for the next German nouns
- `get_stats`: How many German words have I learned in Der Die Das?
